description: This file defines a middleware component for an ASP.NET Core application that handles exceptions occurring during HTTP request processing. It captures exceptions, logs errors, and serializes error responses to the client in JSON format.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling exceptions and formatting error responses in an ASP.NET Core application.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that invokes the next delegate and handles exceptions.

methods.description: Private method that processes exceptions, logs them, and writes error responses.
